why: Women's knit jackets, dresses, suiting and evening wear, with jackets and dresses often $1,200–1,700, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.
origin: Founded in Southern California, United States in 1962 by Marie Gray.

doors.note: site stjohnknits.com (/stores is a 404; the locator is /pages/store-locator); 32 US stores: 18 St. John Boutiques and 14 St. John Outlets (named as outlets by the locator); the 33rd entry is 'St John Knits HQ' (Anaheim office), not a store, not returned; the app's own config reports 34 locations, 1 more than it lists, and the 34th could not be seen; the list gives no phone numbers; no concessions listed; brand writes St. John (key matches)

craft_evidence.owned: claim only: craftsmanship page says yarns, buttons and trims are 'created by brand artisans'; no named facility or place on the site
craft_evidence.mills: no (Harris Tweed named on one style as a cloth; no mill)

craft_evidence.heritage: dated and loosely placed: founded in Southern California in 1962 by Marie Gray (our-story page)
craft_evidence.reasoning: The our-story page dates the founding to 1962 in Southern California. The craftsmanship page claims that brand artisans make yarns, buttons and trims but names no factory or place. Product pages state no country of origin. The house's reputation for in-house knitting is not shown on its own site, so it earns nothing here.
